## 3e68f3e3f66f

**Classification:** Reproduced lesson-level shortcut; audit only, no source
changed.

The plausible rival is: **copy at most the first three row-major eligible motif
cells** around the first color-5 source. It otherwise uses the intended legend,
row-major color-6 anchor ordering, translation, recoloring, clipping, and
copy-overwrite behavior. This rival fits all 5/5 canonical pairs because every
canonical motif has exactly three eligible cells.

The current generator does emit a four-cell `sparse_wide_motif`, but its profile
is selected independently for each pair and there is no lesson-identifiability
hook. A concrete default medium lesson is seed `13`, sequential sample indices
`0..3`:

| Role | sample index | profile | rival matches Racket |
|---|---:|---|---|
| demo | 0 | `clipped_copy` | yes |
| demo | 1 | `single_broadcast` | yes |
| demo | 2 | `legend_colored_motif` | yes |
| query | 3 | `sparse_wide_motif` | **no** |

At query cell `(9,17)`, zero-indexed, the selected Racket rule writes color 9
from the fourth motif cell; the rival leaves 0. Thus the three demonstrations do
not determine the query under this rival even though the global pool contains a
counterexample profile.

Hashes: generator
`b250f517e5ab3c165640f00fc87e04e593ff3cd58098ec9da4f842ca33ff58f8`;
executed/catalog rule `4f92f2063a9e` (match). The four grids are emitted by the
target generator itself. Exact inputs, Racket outputs, rival outputs, command,
working directory, hashes, and first difference are retained in
`checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/finding.json`; the supported apply receipt is
`checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/racket.json`.

**Suggested future repair:** add this rival to a semantic contract and schedule
at least one four-cell motif in every demonstration set, rather than relying on
uniform global profile frequency.

## 3e68f3e3f66f

**Finding: independently reproduced unresolved production lesson-level shortcut. Audited source unchanged.** Generator SHA-256: `b250f517e5ab3c165640f00fc87e04e593ff3cd58098ec9da4f842ca33ff58f8`; selected/executed rule hash: `4f92f2063a9e` (match).

The rival copies only the first three row-major eligible motif cells, retaining the intended legend, first source, row-major destination ordering, translation, recoloring, clipping, and copy overwrite behavior. It fits **5/5 labelled canonical pairs**, whose motifs each contain exactly three eligible cells.

A bounded fresh probe reproduced this default medium lesson at seed `13`, with no profile overrides:

| Role | Sample index | Emitted profile | Rival matches Racket |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Demo | 0 | `clipped_copy` | Yes |
| Demo | 1 | `single_broadcast` | Yes |
| Demo | 2 | `legend_colored_motif` | Yes |
| Query | 3 | `sparse_wide_motif` | **No** |

All four emitted inputs pass `self_check`; their Python-mirror outputs match fresh selected-rule Racket execution. On query cell `(9,17)`, zero-indexed, Racket paints `9` from the fourth motif cell; the rival leaves `0`. Thus the demonstrations do not refute this canonical-fitting rival before it changes the query. This is a production sampling finding, not a validator-only mutation. The generator independently samples profiles and declares no `lesson_identifiable` hook. The finding independently confirms the two same-source unresolved audit records already in the current review index; it is not claimed as a new distinct defect.

Evidence:

- [checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/finding.json](checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/finding.json): source/rule hashes, seed, difficulty, indices, canonical counts, per-input hashes, rival outputs, exact differing cells, commands, cwd and exit codes.
- [checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/input.json](checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/input.json): four exact generated inputs.
- [checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/racket.json](checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/racket.json): fresh supported selected-rule apply receipt with all four oracle outputs.
- [checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/probe.py](checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/probe.py): executable bounded reproduction.
- [checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/apply.log](checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/apply.log): wrapper/apply execution log.

From cwd `/workspace/scratch/944df838b1d1/packet/WORK/repo`, the probe command `/workspace/scratch/944df838b1d1/packet/WORK/.venv/bin/python ../checks/audit/3e68f3e3f66f/probe.py` exited **0**. The probe invokes the supported `run_with_racket.py` wrapper with the absolute environment Python and `python -m arcpuzzles apply`; that command also exited **0**. It confirmed source bytes unchanged afterward. This audit ran four generated pairs and five canonical comparisons, not a full battery or prevalence census.

**Suggested repair:** register the first-three-cells rival and ensure every demonstration set contains sufficient four-cell motif evidence, including redundancy if arbitrary query rotation is required. Mere global availability of the `sparse_wide_motif` profile does not provide that guarantee.
